ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $\odot O$ is the circumcircle of $\triangle ABD$, where AB is the diameter of $\odot O$, and CD is a chord of $\odot O$. If $\angle ABD = 58^\circ$, then what is the measure of $\angle BCD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: \textbf{Solution:} Given that $\angle ABD=58^\circ$, we can then find that $\angle A=90^\circ-\angle ABD=32^\circ$. Furthermore, in the same or congruent circles, angles subtended by the same or congruent arcs are equal, $\therefore \angle BCD=\angle A=\boxed{32^\circ}$.
